generation: Run the pinned Python teratts_ruaccent.py with local-only assets from the pinned TeraTTSv2 revision. Record normalized text, tokenizer encodings (ids, attention mask, token type ids when declared, offsets and special-token mask), raw argmax decisions for stress usage, yo resolver, homograph choice and character accent, then final text. Never regenerate from floating main/master revisions.

precedence.manual_span: Any + in one <ru>...</ru> span bypasses all automatic RUAccent processing for that span.
precedence.manual_word: The internal accent stage never adds another marker to a word already containing +.
precedence.other_spans: Manual stress in one Russian span does not disable automatic processing in another span. English spans are never changed.

required_records: stress_usage_predictor tokenizer ids/offsets/special mask and labels
yo_homograph_resolver tokenizer ids/offsets/special mask and labels
turbo3.1 omograph pair tokenizer ids/masks and selected variant
nn_accent character ids/masks and primary-stress decisions
